en.headline: Primary One discretionary place results released today for 2027 intake
en.dek: The Education Bureau said 18,148 of 32,104 applicants received discretionary places, with results available from 10am on the e-platform or at schools.
body: The Education Bureau said results of the discretionary places stage of Primary One Admission for the 2027 intake would be released by schools today.

A total of 32,104 children applied for discretionary places at government and aided primary schools, and 18,148 received offers, the bureau said. Of those, 8,270 qualified because a sibling attends the school or a parent works there, while the remaining 9,878 were allocated under the points system.

Parents who have activated the Primary One Admission e-platform account can check results from 10am today. Others may visit the school they applied to between 9am and 5pm with the parent copy of the application form.

Children offered a place must register at the school on Wednesday or Thursday during office hours. The bureau said failure to register without prior arrangement would mean the place is forfeited. About half of each school's Primary One places are filled at the discretionary stage, with the rest reserved for central allocation later.

zh.headline: 小一自行分配學位結果今日公布 進讀二〇二七年小一
zh.dek: 教育局表示，全港官立及資助小學小一入學自行分配學位結果今日公布，家長可於上午10時起透過電子平台或到學校查閱。
body: 教育局表示，今年有三萬二千一百零四名兒童申請官立及資助小學的自行分配學位，其中一萬八千一百四十八人獲派此類學位。
獲派學位的兒童中，八千二百七十人屬於有兄姊在該校就讀或父母在該校就職類別，餘下九千八百七十八人則按計分辦法準則分配。
已啟動「小一入學電子平台」帳戶的家長，可於今日上午10時起透過平台查閱結果。家長亦可於當日上午9時至下午5時，攜同紙本申請表家長副本，前往所申請的小學查閱。
獲得自行分配學位的兒童，家長須於星期三或星期四的學校辦公時間內，前往學校辦理註冊手續。教育局指，如未能按時註冊而未事先聯絡學校，將被視作放棄學位。
